Documentation.UserDocu: What every sheet metal feature has: its rule and its model of the sheet (docs/SheetMetal.md sec 4.2)

sheetElementOf(subname) -> str or None
The name of the wall or bend of the sheet model that owns a face of this feature's shape, None if none owns it.

bendKFactor(bend) -> float or None
The K of a bend this feature made, by its name ("Bend2"), where the bend has one of its own (BendKFactors); None where it takes the rule's.

setBendKFactor(bend, k=None)
Give a bend this feature made, by its name ("Bend2"), a K of its own, from 0 to 1; None gives it back to the rule. It changes that bend's flat and nothing else (docs/SheetMetal.md sec 4.6). Raises ValueError for a bend this feature did not make.

crossBreakLines() -> [Part.Edge]
The cross breaks of this feature's sheet in 3D: the diagonals of the face each rises from, two a wall, as the shape lies (docs/SheetMetal.md sec 12).
